instruction:
Repo /dayjs (dayjs date library, jest). Fix ONE bug in /dayjs/src/plugin/duration/index.js ONLY. Do NOT modify any test file, and do NOT touch any other file (other agents are editing src/plugin/timezone/index.js, src/locale/nl.js, src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js).

BUG: hidden test name is `Creating milliseconds`. Read /dayjs/test/plugin/duration.test.js and /dayjs/docs/en/Plugin.md (the Duration section) first to see the documented/expected behaviour, then investigate empirically with node/jest.

STRONG HYPOTHESIS: the `unitToMS` map in /dayjs/src/plugin/duration/index.js has no `milliseconds` entry (only years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, weeks). Therefore `dayjs.duration(100, 'milliseconds')` and `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms')` produce NaN (because `input * unitToMS[prettyUnit(unit)]` is `100 * undefined`), and `dayjs.duration(100, 'millisecond')` likewise. moment.duration(100, 'milliseconds').milliseconds() === 100 and .asMilliseconds() === 100. Also `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms')` should behave like 100 ms.

TASK: make `dayjs.duration(<n>, 'milliseconds' | 'millisecond' | 'ms')` (and the `{ milliseconds: n }` object form) behave correctly, i.e. equal to moment.duration(n, 'milliseconds'), without breaking anything else. The minimal fix is to add `milliseconds: 1` to the `unitToMS` map (check that `prettyUnit('ms')`/`prettyUnit('milliseconds')` resolve to the key 'milliseconds' via `$u.p` in /dayjs/src/utils.js: it lowercases and strips a trailing 's' → 'millisecond' then the plugin appends 's' → 'milliseconds'). Verify empirically; if a different minimal fix is needed, use it. Keep 2-space indentation and run `npx eslint src/plugin/duration/index.js`.

VERIFY (from /dayjs):
1) Create TEMPORARY file /dayjs/test/plugin/zz_tmp_duration.test.js with EXACTLY:

import moment from 'moment'
import dayjs from '../../src'
import duration from '../../src/plugin/duration'

dayjs.extend(duration)

it('Creating milliseconds', () => {
  const cases = [[100, 'milliseconds'], [100, 'millisecond'], [100, 'ms'], [1500, 'ms'], [0, 'ms'], [-250, 'ms']]
  cases.forEach(([n, u]) => {
    const d = dayjs.duration(n, u)
    const m = moment.duration(n, u)
    console.log(n, u, d.milliseconds(), m.milliseconds(), d.asMilliseconds(), m.asMilliseconds(), d.$ms, m.asMilliseconds())
    expect(d.milliseconds()).toBe(m.milliseconds())
    expect(d.asMilliseconds()).toBe(m.asMilliseconds())
  })
  expect(dayjs.duration({ milliseconds: 100 }).asMilliseconds()).toBe(100)
  expect(dayjs.duration(100).asMilliseconds()).toBe(100)
  expect(dayjs.duration(100).milliseconds()).toBe(100)
  expect(dayjs.duration(1500).milliseconds()).toBe(500)
  expect(dayjs.duration(1, 'seconds').asMilliseconds()).toBe(1000)
  expect(dayjs.duration(1, 's').asMilliseconds()).toBe(1000)
})

Run `npx jest test/plugin/zz_tmp_duration.test.js --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -60`, report console output and pass/fail; iterate until it passes. Then DELETE the temp file and confirm.
2) Run `npx jest test/plugin/duration.test.js --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -30` — must pass.
3) Run the FULL suite `npx jest --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -20` — must be 0 failures (baseline: 56 suites / 524 tests green).
4) `git diff src/plugin/duration/index.js` and `git status --porcelain`.

Report: final diff, temp-test console output and result, duration.test.js result, full-suite totals, any failure/regression, and confirmation the temp file was deleted.

Repo /dayjs (dayjs date library, jest). Fix ONE bug in /dayjs/src/locale/nl.js ONLY. Do NOT modify any test file, and do NOT touch any other file (other agents are editing src/plugin/timezone/index.js, src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js, src/plugin/duration/index.js).

CONTEXT: hidden test name is `Format Day of Month Do 1 - 31` (an extended version of the existing test of that name in /dayjs/test/plugin/advancedFormat.test.js, which compares dayjs output with moment for `Do`). The Dutch locale's `ordinal` is currently `n => `${n}.``, which does not match the Dutch ordinal used by moment's nl locale (moment is installed in /dayjs/node_modules/moment, see /dayjs/node_modules/moment/locale/nl.js: `ordinal: function (number) { return number + (number === 1 || number === 8 || number >= 20 ? 'ste' : 'de') }`).

TASK: change /dayjs/src/locale/nl.js `ordinal` so that `dayjs(d).locale('nl').format('Do')` equals `moment(d).locale('nl').format('Do')` for every day 1..31. Use the moment-compatible rule (1ste, 2de, 3de, ..., 8ste, ..., 20ste ... 31ste), written in dayjs style, e.g.:

  ordinal: (n) => {
    const s = n === 1 || n === 8 || n >= 20 ? 'ste' : 'de'
    return `${n}${s}`
  },

(keep 2-space indentation and the file's eslint style; run `npx eslint src/locale/nl.js` to confirm).

VERIFY (from /dayjs):
1) Create TEMPORARY file /dayjs/test/locale/zz_tmp_nl.test.js with EXACTLY:

import moment from 'moment'
import dayjs from '../../src'
import advancedFormat from '../../src/plugin/advancedFormat'
import nl from '../../src/locale/nl'

dayjs.extend(advancedFormat)

it('Format Day of Month Do 1 - 31', () => {
  dayjs.locale(nl)
  moment.locale('nl')
  for (let i = 1; i <= 31; i += 1) {
    const d = `2018-05-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`
    console.log(i, dayjs(d).format('Do'), moment(d).format('Do'))
    expect(dayjs(d).format('Do')).toBe(moment(d).format('Do'))
  }
  const d = '2018-05-02'
  expect(dayjs(d).locale('nl').format('Do')).toBe(moment(d).locale('nl').format('Do'))
})

Run `npx jest test/locale/zz_tmp_nl.test.js --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -40`, report output, then DELETE the file (rm) and confirm it is gone. If the comparison with moment fails, adjust the ordinal rule until all 31 days match moment, and report the final rule.
2) Run `npx jest test/plugin/advancedFormat.test.js test/locale/keys.test.js --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -20` (must pass).
3) Run the FULL suite `npx jest --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -20` — must be 0 failures (baseline: 56 suites / 524 tests all green).
4) `git diff src/locale/nl.js` and `git status --porcelain`.

Report: final diff, the 31 console lines, temp-test result, full-suite totals, any failure, and confirmation the temp file was deleted.
